definitions.explanation: A characteristic or aspect that two or more things share; a similarity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{共通点|きょうつうてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: The two of them have a lot in common.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{共通点|きょうつうてん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なん}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: What is the common point between these two problems?

examples.japanese: {共通点|きょうつうてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つける→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{理解|りかい}→理解：03674_rikai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{深|ふか}まる→深まる：02406_fukamaru⟧。
examples.english: By finding common points, understanding deepens.

notes:
{共通点|きょうつうてん} combines ⟦{共通|きょうつう}→共通：02590_kyoutsuu⟧ (common) + ⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧ (point).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {共通点|きょうつうてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to have something in common)
- {共通点|きょうつうてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つける→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧ (to find common ground)
- {共通点|きょうつうてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧/⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧ (to have much/little in common)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{共通|きょうつう}→共通：02590_kyoutsuu⟧ (common, shared)
- ⟦{相違点|そういてん}→相違点：17928_souiten⟧ (point of difference) - antonym
- ⟦{類似点|るいじてん}→類似点：24577_ruijiten⟧ (point of similarity)

USAGE:
- Often used when comparing people, ideas, or things
- Common in academic and analytical contexts
